method: Reviewed the complete lesson, its metadata/source registrations, MCP 2026-07-28 Tools specification, JSON Schema object reference, and official MCP Python SDK v2 tools documentation. Executed the whole local LangChain Core example and its invalid-argument checks; provider credentials were not used.

observations.trace: Python 3.10.9; langchain-core 0.3.63; A/B/C schemas matched the lesson (A and B require city/day/passengers; constructed C omits required).

limitations: The C MCP schema is constructed fixture data, not a live tools/list response. No deployed server behavior or business validation was tested.
The official MCP Python SDK docs are on the mutable main branch and describe SDK v2; a target server must be checked against its exact installed release.
The local test supports schema output and validation behavior for LangChain Core 0.3.63 only; it does not prove provider-side or cross-framework guarantees.
